verdict.rationale: Kit publishes a detailed per-endpoint V4 API reference (broadcasts, accounts, custom fields) with machine-readable .md pages and an llms.txt index. A Developer Docs MCP also lets AI agents query the live reference, which gives AI-native users a way to explore it. However, nothing in the evidence shows an in-browser interactive 'try it' console or runnable request examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: interactive try-it/API playground, runnable code examples per endpoint, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
